observations: Photo 0 shows a car engine/engine assembly on the ground with hoses/wiring and visible intake/engine covers; it appears partially disassembled or removed from a vehicle.
Photo 1 shows the same engine from another angle; the top cover and surrounding components are visible, with dirt/grease and some exposed metal parts.
Photo 2 shows the engine from a third angle; the intake/cover area and wiring/hoses are visible; no clear VIN/engine code plate is readable.

claims.claim: We also deals in all kinds of car spare parts
claims.evidence: Seller text only; photos show an engine assembly but do not confirm the seller’s business scope.

risks.risk: Exact engine make/model and compatibility are not readable from the photos (no clear engine code/label). Wrong engine = wrong fit and unusable purchase.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the engine identification plate/engine code stamping (and/or the VIN/part number label) plus a photo showing the engine bay where it came from.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as an unknown used engine assembly with compatibility risk (worst case: not guaranteed to fit).

risks.risk: Condition/working status is unknown; photos show an engine removed with exposed components and no proof it runs.
risks.proof: Video of the engine running (cold start if possible) or a short test run with sound + dashboard/ECU scan showing no active faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not proven working (worst case: assume it may be faulty).

risks.risk: Missing parts or damage (hoses, sensors, brackets, mounts, connectors) may be present; photos don’t show a complete inventory.
risks.proof: A full laid-out inventory photo of all included parts (connectors, sensors, alternator/starter, turbo if any, mounts) and close-ups of any broken areas.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst case: treat as missing some parts).

risks.risk: Internal wear (compression, timing, head gasket, bearings) cannot be assessed visually from these angles.
risks.proof: Compression test results and/or leak-down test report; also photos of cylinder head/valve cover condition if accessible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown internal condition (worst case: assume major wear).

risks.risk: Shipping/handling risk: engine assemblies are heavy; damage can occur during transport and may not be visible in photos.
risks.proof: Packaging/loading video and photos of the engine after loading; also request for delivery inspection checklist.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as standard used item without transport guarantees (worst case: damage possible).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the engine code/identification plate (and any part number labels) so the exact engine can be matched.
Video of the engine running (or a test-run report) showing it starts and idles smoothly.
Photos showing what is included: alternator, starter, sensors, ECU/loom (if included), mounts, and any accessories.
Compression/leak-down test results (or a mechanic’s report) to confirm internal health.
response.reason: The photos show an engine assembly, but the exact make/model and working condition are not verifiable remotely (no readable engine code/compatibility info and no run/test proof). To price safely, we need identification and proof it works.
